label: early-original-phase y/s input (positions 2-5)
explanation: Fires only in the original (input) phase, at positions 2-5 (peak t=3, about 45% of mass). It never fires at t=0, on the delimiter, or in the copy phase. The input token gates it: y (12x lift, 46% of mass) and s (7x, 24%) dominate, with weaker j, g, e. Activations are almost always on the first occurrence of the token. The strongest activations (near max) are y at t=3-4, often after prefixes that start with o/d/u or contain f/p/0. That prefix dependence is real but diffuse: requiring such a prefix raises precision only from 0.31 to 0.43 and costs recall. The predicate covers 80% of the top quartile but only 38% of the bottom quartile; weak activations spread across many other letters. Precision is low because most y/s inputs at these positions stay below threshold, depending on prefix context the predicate does not capture.
